summary: Telefônica Brasil S.A. filed a Form 6-K announcing a board-approved declaration of Interest on Capital (IoC), a Brazilian corporate distribution akin to a dividend. The gross amount is R$600,000,000 (six hundred million reais), with a 17.5% withholding tax resulting in net R$495,000,000. The gross amount per share is R$0.18775779427, net R$0.15490018027. The record date is May 27, 2026, after which shares trade ex-IoC, and payment is due by May 30, 2027. This IoC is treated as part of mandatory dividends for FY2026, subject to shareholder ratification at the 2027 AGM. The distribution reflects ongoing capital return to shareholders, a special situation categorized as Capital Returns.
